changeSet.author: Adam Mudrak
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE restaurants ADD COLUMN time_zone VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Europe/Kyiv'; ALTER TABLE order_items ADD COLUMN fulfillment_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ORDERED', ADD COLUMN request_key VARCHAR(128) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NULL, ADD COLUMN request_fingerprint VARCHAR(64) NULL, ADD CONSTRAINT uk_guest_request UNIQUE (guest_id, request_key); UPDATE order_items SET fulfillment_status = CASE WHEN status IN ('PAID_CARD', 'PAID_CASH') THEN 'CONFIRMED' ELSE status END; ALTER TABLE payments ADD COLUMN resolution_note VARCHAR(2000) NULL, ADD COLUMN resolved_at DATETIME(6) NULL, ADD COLUMN resolved_by_id BIGINT NULL, ADD CONSTRAINT fk_payment_resolved_by FOREIGN KEY (resolved_by_id) REFERENCES employees(id); CREATE TABLE payment_refunds ( id BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, payment_id BIGINT NOT NULL UNIQUE, requested_by_id BIGINT NOT NULL, reason VARCHAR(1000) NOT NULL, amount DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, attempts INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, provider_refund_id VARCHAR(255) NULL, error VARCHAR(1024) NULL, created_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL, completed_at DATETIME(6) NULL, CONSTRAINT fk_refund_payment FOREIGN KEY (payment_id) REFERENCES payments(id), CONSTRAINT fk_refund_employee FOREIGN KEY (requested_by_id) REFERENCES employees(id) );
